 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. FC Augsburg are known for one thing above all this season: lightning-fast goals!
 In the 2-2 draw against FC Bayern, Robin Fellhauer scored after just 8.4 seconds—the fastest goal in Bundesliga history.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Things weren't quite that quick today, but Manuel Baum's fast starters were once again off the mark at top speed against RB Leipzig.
 After 37 seconds, Germany U21 international Anton Kade tapped in a rebound to make it 1-0.
 Surely word should have got around by now that you need to be switched on from the very start against Augsburg...
